rule: Owner decisions O36/O37 (2026-10-21): every ranked configuration has all eleven quality leaves. A leaf the primary source lacks comes, in order, from a newer capture of the same primary source (aa_recapture), from another party that ran the same benchmark version on the exact configuration (independent; Cognition counts for FrontierCode), or from the model provider's own published result (model_provider_claim). Each leaf a cohort configuration still lacks has an exhaustive search logged here within 7 days of the release cutoff.

sourceRegistry._note: E239 (2026-10-21): the closed per-leaf list of parties whose run of the same benchmark version may fill a leaf (O36/O37); a provider claim is the model provider's own document. A new source enters by a dated registry update recorded in the ledger.
